{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# data-model.md updates
p="specs/001-transactions/data-model.md"
s=open(p).read()
old="""| Operation | Transition |
|---|---|
| `put(k, v, tags)` new key | add entry (deepcopy v, frozenset tags); if over capacity, evict LRU entry(s) via `_remove` (cleans both indexes + LRU order). |
| `put(k, v, tags)` existing key | drop k's old tag memberships; store new deepcopy; register new tags; k moves to MRU (LRUCache `__setitem__` semantics; Claim-A). |
| `put` invalid tags | no transition; `ValueError` raised before mutation. |
| `get(k)` hit | return deepcopy; k moves to MRU. |
| `get(k)` miss | `KeyError`; no state change. |
| `invalidate(t)` | remove all keys in `self._tag_keys[t]` via `_remove`; return count; drop t's index entry. |
| LRU eviction (internal, during put) | evicted key removed via `_remove` — index cleanup identical to explicit delete, so no stale memberships (R02). |
| `__init__` invalid maxsize | no object state; `ValueError`. |"""
new="""| Operation | Transition |
|---|---|
| `put(k, v, tags)` new key | add entry (deepcopy v, frozenset tags); if over capacity, evict LRU entry(s) via `_remove` (cleans both indexes + LRU order). |
| `put(k, v, tags)` existing key | drop k's old tag memberships; store new deepcopy; register new tags; k moves to MRU (LRUCache `__setitem__` semantics; Claim-A). |
| `put` invalid tags | no transition; `ValueError` raised before mutation. |
| `get(k)` hit | return deepcopy; k moves to MRU. |
| `get(k)` miss | `KeyError`; no state change. |
| `invalidate(t)` | remove all keys in `self._tag_keys[t]` via `_remove`; return count; drop t's index entry. |
| `invalidate_many(tags, mode)` | validate mode+tags first; matched = union (any) or intersection (all) of tag sets; empty tag set -> 0 removed in both modes; remove matched keys via `_remove`; return distinct count. |
| `invalidate_many` invalid mode/tags | no transition; `ValueError` before mutation. |
| `resize(n)` valid, shrinking | evict LRU entries via `popitem()` + `_remove` until `len <= n`; update capacity attribute; survivors keep order/state. |
| `resize(n)` valid, growing | update capacity attribute only; no eviction. |
| `resize(n)` invalid | no transition; `ValueError`; entries/tags/order/capacity unchanged. |
| LRU eviction (internal, during put) | evicted key removed via `_remove` — index cleanup identical to explicit delete, so no stale memberships (R02). |
| `__init__` invalid maxsize | no object state; `ValueError`. |"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old2="""| `maxsize` | `isinstance(int)`, not `bool`, `> 0` | `ValueError` |"""
new2="""| `maxsize` (init) | `isinstance(int)`, not `bool`, `> 0` | `ValueError` |
| `resize` capacity | same rule as init `maxsize` | `ValueError` |
| `invalidate_many` mode | must be `'any'` or `'all'` | `ValueError` |
| `invalidate_many` tags | same rules as `put` tags | `ValueError` |"""
assert old2 in s
s=s.replace(old2,new2,1)
old3="""5. `invalidate(t)` returns `len(self._tag_keys.get(t, ()))` and removes
   exactly those keys."""
new3="""5. `invalidate(t)` returns `len(self._tag_keys.get(t, ()))` and removes
   exactly those keys.
7. After any successful `resize(n)`: `maxsize == n`, surviving entries
   are exactly those not evicted, their LRU order is unchanged, and no
   tag index references an evicted or removed key.
8. `invalidate_many` with an empty requested tag set removes zero
   entries in both modes (supersedes old design note)."""
assert old3 in s
s=s.replace(old3,new3,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("data-model.md lines:", s.count(chr(10)))

# contracts update
cp="specs/001-transactions/contracts/tagged-cache-api.md"
c=open(cp).read()
anchor="""### Dunder / mapping-adjacent behavior"""
add="""### `invalidate_many(tags, mode='any') -> int`

- `tags`: same rules as `put` tags (finite iterable of `str`, dedup,
  generators consumed once, bare string rejected).
- `mode`: `'any'` (default) removes entries carrying at least one
  requested tag; `'all'` removes entries carrying every requested tag.
- Empty requested tag collection removes zero entries in either mode.
- Returns the number of distinct removed keys.
- Invalid `mode` or invalid `tags` -> `ValueError` before any mutation.
- For a single tag, behavior is identical to `invalidate(tag)`.

### `resize(maxsize) -> None`

- Validates capacity with the constructor rule (positive `int`, `bool`
  excluded) BEFORE any change; violation -> `ValueError` with all state
  (entries, tags, recency order, current capacity) unchanged.
- Shrinking evicts least-recently-used entries until the cache fits;
  growing evicts nothing.
- Surviving entries keep their LRU order and stored state (no
  re-copying, no reordering).

### `maxsize` (property) -> int

- Reports the current capacity (after any successful `resize`).

### Dunder / mapping-adjacent behavior"""
c=c.replace(anchor,add,1)
anchor2="""| `get` missing key | `KeyError` |
| unhashable key | `TypeError` (Python standard) |"""
anchor2b="""| `get` missing key | `KeyError` |
| invalid `invalidate_many` mode or tags | `ValueError` |
| invalid `resize` capacity | `ValueError` |
| unhashable key | `TypeError` (Python standard) |"""
assert anchor2 in c
c=c.replace(anchor2,anchor2b,1)
anchor3="""- No tag normalization; no tag query API beyond `invalidate`."""
anchor3b="""- No tag normalization; no tag query API beyond `invalidate` /
  `invalidate_many`.
- No TTL/expiry (not in the frozen requirement set; see spec.md
  Assumptions for the Claim-A round-2 clarification)."""
assert anchor3 in c
c=c.replace(anchor3,anchor3b,1)
open(cp,"w").write(c)
print("contract lines:", c.count(chr(10)))
PYEOF"}
